statement: `meetings` is a list of [start, end] pairs of integers describing half-open time intervals [start, end). Two meetings conflict when their intervals overlap; a meeting that ends at time t does not conflict with one that starts at t. Any pair with start >= end is an empty meeting that needs no room and is ignored. Return the minimum number of rooms needed so that every non-empty meeting can be held in a room with no conflicting meeting. Return 0 for an empty list.
